name: Agilest Light

origin.basis: Panaracer Corporation is headquartered in Tamba City, Hyogo, Japan (company page).

manufacturing.basis: Panaracer USA does not state where these tires are made.

weight_basis: Panaracer USA store weights per size.

availability.note: Sold by Panaracer USA's web store; mainland China and European availability not verified for this model.

price_observations.conditions: Official store price on 2026-11-01; one tire; every size was out of stock.

caveats: Every size was out of stock in the US store on 2026-11-01.
Very light race construction; expect less cut protection than the Agilest or Agilest Duro.

image.shown: 700x23 black Agilest Light (part RF723-AGL-B) as pictured on Panaracer USA's product page.
image.alt: Panaracer Agilest Light road tire mounted on a carbon wheel

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-04 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, reviews without riding detail, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Comments on one construction's test page count for that construction unless the owner names the other.

checks.note: Two listings with no written review
